LESSON PLAN CRE ACTIVITES
 Week: Lesson:
 SCHOOL GRADE DATE TIME ROLL
 TWO
STRAND/THEME/TOPIC: THE EARLY LIFE OF JESUS CHRIST
SUBSTRAND/SUB-THEME/SUB-TOPIC: THE KINDNESS OF THE WISEMEN
Specific lesson learning outcome.
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be to list the gifts given to baby Jesus and develop the value of sharing.
KEY INQUIRY QUESTION (s)
 Why should we share gifts?
 Core competencies Values PCIs
  Critical thinking  Faith Self-awareness
  Problem solving  Sharing Self-esteem
  self-awareness  Love and unity
  Decision making  Kindness
  obedience
LEARNING RESOURCES
Bible
Video clips
C.R.E activities Learner’s Book Grade 2 pg. 61-66
C.R.E Activities Teacher’s Guide Grade 2 pg. 35-38
ORGANIZATION OF LEARNING
Learners to work in pairs or groups
INTRODUCTION
Learners to sing a familiar song on baby Jesus
LESSON DEVELOPMENT (Assessment as learning)
 Step 1: Learners to Read the story in Mathew 2:11
 Step 2: Guide learners in naming the gifts brought to baby Jesus by the three wise men.
 Step 3: Ask learners the lessons they learn from the three wise men and develop the value of sharing.
SUMMARY
We should be kind.
CONCLUSION (Assessment of Learning)
Learners to recite Mathew 2:11
EXTENSION OF ACTIVITIES
Learners to participate in community activities e.g. Christmas time where people give gifts.

 TWO
STRAND/THEME/TOPIC: THE EARLY LIFE OF JESUS CHRIST
SUBSTRAND/SUB-THEME/SUB-TOPIC: THE KINDNESS OF THE WISEMEN
Specific lesson learning outcome.
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be to acquire the skill of assertiveness, by refusing gifts from strangers
and appreciate Jesus as a gift from God, in their lives.
KEY INQUIRY QUESTION (s)
 Why should we not receive gifts from strangers?
 Core competencies Values PCIs
  Critical thinking  Faith Self-awareness
  Problem solving  Sharing Self-esteem
  self-awareness  Love and unity
  Decision making  Kindness
  obedience
LEARNING RESOURCES
Bible
Video clips
C.R.E activities Learner’s Book Grade 2 pg. 61-66
C.R.E Activities Teacher’s Guide Grade 2 pg. 35-38
ORGANIZATION OF LEARNING
Learners to work in pairs or groups
INTRODUCTION
Learners to sing a familiar song on baby Jesus
LESSON DEVELOPMENT (Assessment as learning)
 Step 1: Learners to Read the story in Mathew 2:11
 Step 2: Guide learners to role-play saying “thank you”, after receiving gifts from friends and family members
 using flash cards.
 Step 3: Guide learners to understand why they should avoid receiving gifts from strangers.
 Step 4: Learners to appreciate baby Jesus as a gift from God.
SUMMARY
We should not accept gifts from strangers.
CONCLUSION (Assessment of Learning)
Learners to recite Mathew 2:11
EXTENSION OF ACTIVITIES
Learners to participate in community activities e.g. Christmas time where people give gifts.

SUBSTRAND/SUB-THEME/SUB-TOPIC: JESUS CHRIST WORKED
Specific lesson learning outcome.
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be to develop responsibility by doing simple chores at home, in school
and the church.
KEY INQUIRY QUESTION (s)
 Why should we help our parents/work?
 Core competencies Values PCIs
  Critical thinking  Trust Self-awareness
  Problem solving  Responsibility Self-esteem
  self-awareness  Love
  Decision making  Obedience
  Humility and respect
LEARNING RESOURCES
Bible
C.R.E activities Learner’s Book Grade 2 pg. 67-70
C.R.E Activities Teacher’s Guide Grade 2 pg. 39-40
ORGANIZATION OF LEARNING
Learners to work in pairs or groups
INTRODUCTION
Learners to sing a familiar song on baby Jesus
LESSON DEVELOPMENT (Assessment as learning)
 Step 1: Explain to the learners the type of work Jesus did at home to help his father Joseph. i.e. carpentry
 Step 2: Guide learners in groups to list how Jesus helped his father.
 Step 3: Learners to write a poem on “Jesus worked”.
SUMMARY
Review the lesson and make summary
CONCLUSION (Assessment of Learning)
Learners to recite the poem
EXTENSION OF ACTIVITIES
Learners to participate in different activities or work in the community, interacting and learning from them.

Specific lesson learning outcome.

it to their lives by trusting in God.
KEY INQUIRY QUESTION (s)
 Why should we have trust in God?

  Critical thinking  Faith Self-awareness
  Problem solving  Obedience Self-esteem

Bible
Video clip
C.R.E activities Learner’s Book Grade 2 pg. 73-75

ORGANIZATION OF LEARNING
Learners to work in pairs or groups
INTRODUCTION
Learners to sing a familiar song

 Step 1: Guide learners to read Luke 5:3-9
 Step 2: Guide learners in watching a video clip on the miraculous catch of fish.
 Step 3: Explain to the learners the importance of having faith in God.

SUMMARY
We should trust in God.
CONCLUSION (Assessment of Learning)
Learners to sing a song.
